shots.x: Ink. The nib goes in, comes out loaded, and makes the first stroke of a letter to a king.
Her room at night, one lamp, the city asleep outside. She is writing fast, which she was never taught to do.
Her hand presses the seal into the wax, and holds it there a beat too long.
Her face over the sealed letter. She says the line to nobody, and it is the thesis of the film.
shots.dlg: Rukmini: They will say a woman was stolen. Let them. I am the one holding the pen.
shots.te: ఒక ఆడపిల్లను ఎత్తుకుపోయారని అంటారు. అననివ్వండి — కలం పట్టుకున్నది నేనే.

shots.x: The letter goes into the Brahmin's hands and disappears into his clothes.
